analysis: Documentation-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md. Visible head-side additions: a note on shutdown waiting up to 15 seconds per model unload (`ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown`), and a rewritten `darkbloom status` bullet at head lines ~1289-1307 covering the enabled_models restart-needed notice, Autopilot placements, and retry-when-memory-frees lines. The patch excerpt is truncated, so other edits in the file may not have been shown. Examined the two head-text units (lines 1237-2124) against the threat model. No code, key handling, attestation, authorization, wire protocol or cache storage behavior changes. The status additions expose only local configuration diffs and model names to the local operator via `status`, derived from daemon-state.json fields (`enabled_models_at_start`, `enabled_models_at_last_switch`). They carry no consumer prompt data (A-001), keys (A-003) or tokens (A-008). The doc states model names and load figures remain private in `darkbloom logs`, which is consistent with existing log-redaction posture. The shutdown-timeout note says a model whose native retirement never finishes is left to process exit. That bears on T-028 residual GPU memory, T-029 and T-010. It is a documented bounded wait and does not weaken the stated controls. Unverified: whether the code `ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown` matches the docs, since no source was supplied. Also unverified: whether the Traffic/refusal/sandbox descriptions remain accurate. These are unchanged context, not part of the visible change. Cache/SSD text (T-041) is unchanged in kind, and the surrounding Slot posture text refers only to existing status vocabularies. No new attack surface or invalidated threat assumptions identified.
